name: victor-portfolio
description: Porfolio site for my web development and web copy projects

paragraphs: An immersive neon-blue-on-black portfolio with a built-in admin dashboard. You publish web projects, film, articles, executive op-eds, short stories, branding copy, copywriting, press copy, speeches and certifications from the browser. Nothing is edited in the codebase.

Stack: Next.js (server-rendered, so Google and AI assistants read every page), React, Tailwind, three.js + react-three-fiber (only for the work ring), Lenis smooth scroll, Supabase (database, login, file storage).
features: Work ring (GLSL): your featured projects on a scroll-driven 3D carousel, with a ripple and
The ring is downloaded only when you scroll close to it. Reduced-motion and data-saver visitors get no video
